record.synthesis_method: high-energy ball milling followed by annealing
record.evidence_quote: Specifically, Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 (Cl1.5) exhibits an ionic conductivity of 4.5 mS cm−1, compared with 2.3 mS cm−1 for Li6PS5Cl (Cl1.0)
record.evidence_location: Results, first paragraph of Introduction section (p. 4)
record.notes: Value is cited to Supplementary Fig. 1; the EIS temperature (298 K) and method come from the Methods EIS section, which describes the pellet measurements of the synthesized electrolytes. Conductivity is derived from total electrolyte resistance R, hence 'total'. Annealing at 550 °C is a crystallization step, not a sintering step, so sintering fields are null.
